findings.where: First screen (hero) at both widths, and the whole page: no contact action or shown address anywhere. The nav has only Profile, Articles and Blog, with no Contact item. The 'address strip' the palette and texture notes describe is never built: the texture specimen holds only a small yellow block.
findings.fault: The page's one action, getting in touch with Mark, is missing. The parts map lists no mailto link, no contact link and no contact button, and Mark.Moseley@MMMinfra.com appears nowhere. A visitor who is persuaded has nothing to act on.
findings.who_objects: A development-bank officer who has read Mark's line and wants to reach him finds no way to do it here and has to go searching or give up. The founder would object too: the brief makes 'one direct, personal way to reach him', with the address shown, a pass condition of the first screen.

findings.where: Article specimen, Download list: the link 'Streamlining the PPP Process: Meeting the ‘Abundance’ Challenge'
findings.fault: It looks like a working PDF download (blue, underlined, marked 'PDF'), but its href is '#', so clicking it only jumps to the top of the page.
findings.who_objects: A reader who wants the lecture clicks and gets nothing, on the part the research names as the product (the PDF list). The founder can't judge whether the download step works in this tile.

findings.where: Motion sketch: the 'Replay the entrance' control
findings.fault: It is a button that acts on the page, but it wears the link's reserved look (blue text, underlined), so it reads as navigation to somewhere else rather than an action that happens here.
findings.who_objects: The founder, who replays the motion to judge it, may hesitate in case it opens a new page. It also blurs this sheet's own rule that blue underline means a link.

findings.where: Palette: the Pad yellow swatch (desktop and phone)
findings.fault: This static swatch alone has a blue edge, and blue is the colour the sheet reserves for links and focus. It looks like a selected or focused option among the four swatches, but it does nothing.
findings.who_objects: The founder, reading the palette, may take it as the chosen option or try clicking it. Its blue edge also says something the swatch's own label, 'the address strip, selected text', does not.
